title: AI Brain downgrades an automatic order after negative news
story: The rule-based gatekeeper would auto-run $400 of a $1,500 USDC order into Aave. A breaking headline says USDC liquidity is thinning while the peg model still reads 'normal'. The AI Brain weighs the conflict and pulls the $400 back to 'needs your approval' — it can tighten the decision, never loosen it. Step 3 shows the alternative: the model keeps it automatic but sizes it down.
